svg.text: Interface board (terminal base and point-to-point builds)
Adafruit Perma-Proto half-sized PCB (1609), component side. Holes are row and column (c2 = row 2, column c).
Before fitting the IC: e10, e14, e16, f12, f15 beep to GND; e13, f10, f11, f14 beep to 5 V; 5 V to GND doesn't beep; c6 and c7 each read 4.7 kΩ to c2.
